So this never ever came up before last night...

Assume a 4 player game (Players A, B, C, D). There is a Political Flux
in play, indicating that the next person who ousts their prey gets 1
pool instead of the regular 6. Player A calls a vote that ousts
players B and C simultaneously. Who gets the 1 pool? Players A and B
(although B dies before he gets it)? Just player B (who dies before he
gets it) so that player A gets 6? Player A, as he is the only one who
gets pool from the ousting? And why?

(Really, when this came up, it was when there were only 3 players
left, so it was moot, but we were confused and wondered what would
happen if there were 4 or 5 still at the table.)

Thanks!
-Peter
